In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification, isolation and molecular characterization of HIV‐1‐specific antibodies from an HIV‐infected individual who is a long‐term survivor.
the molecular mechanisms that underlie the generation of protective immunity to HIV‐1 in long‐term nonprogressors.
understanding the molecular mechanisms of HIV‐1‐specific antibody responses in long‐term nonprogressors and the role of these responses in controlling HIV‐1 infection.
